summary: Third Coast Bancshares filed an 8-K disclosing an Agreement and Plan of Reorganization, signed October 6, 2026, to acquire Great Plains Bancshares, parent of Great Plains National Bank, via integrated mergers. Consideration is stock: an exchange ratio of 5,570,352 TCBX shares divided by Great Plains shares outstanding, subject to reduction if Great Plains tangible capital falls below $153.3 million. Great Plains merges into a Third Coast subsidiary, then into Third Coast, with Great Plains Bank merging into Third Coast Bank. Watch closing conditions, regulatory approvals, and the tangible-capital adjustment.
